claim: To raise an ineffective assistance of counsel claim on direct appeal, a defendant must make specific allegations of the conduct that constitutes deficient performance, and failure to do so renders the claim insufficiently alleged.
initial_reasoning: 984 N.W.2d 261 holds that on direct appeal an ineffective‑assistance claim must allege specific conduct that constitutes deficient performance; failure to make such allegations renders the claim insufficiently alleged.

final_reasoning: 984 N.W.2d 261 (N.D. 2009) expressly requires that an ineffective‑assistance claim on direct appeal allege the specific conduct that constitutes deficient performance; without such allegations the claim is deemed insufficiently alleged.
